components.description: Flat chronological record connected to the shared trace rail.

narrative.overview: Routing history is operational evidence laid onto a precise work surface. A single blue trace rail makes chronology tangible while restrained rules keep dense records scannable.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Blue describes routing structure or interaction; it is not decorative fill.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when character alignment or machine identity carries meaning.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Routing records never float; they register against the shared rail.

dos: Do preserve the continuous routing rail across responsive layouts.
Do pair every state color with a readable status label.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glow, glass, or decorative shadows.
Don't expose full prompt content by default.
